title: Florenzi factory occupation and January hunger-strike escalation
notes: The Florenzi occupation began before January 2021. Gato Encerrado January 9 and Alharaca describe a June 2020 camp; other accounts give July 8 or July 17. Distinctions among dismissal, camp, factory occupation and barricade dates are unresolved, so onset and owner month remain null. Four women began a hunger strike January 8, not all 113 affected workers. Government justice and expropriation demands are documented. The January 25 internal split was not complete camp closure. Alharaca reports the camp cleared by May 1 without an exact departure day; do not infer April 29 from a press conference. Threshold at the concurrent physical camp and dates of governmental reception remain open.

title: Puerto El Triunfo December 11 municipal strike
notes: ORMUSA describes a December 11, 2020 strike and salary/bonus agreement, with unpaid debts still reported in January. Agreement is not physical departure. Continuous occupation and a distinct January physical assembly are unverified. Original LPG January article returned HTTP 403; E012 remains pending evidence.
